new_claims.statement: For every fixed quadratic polynomial and bounded open interval, the supremum of interval concentration over independent cap-one laws equals the supremum over compact measure-one indicator densities, and equivalently over finite unions of bounded intervals by total-variation approximation; no support-radius or moment bound is introduced.
For every fixed tau in (0,1], the matrices S_m direct_sum J_m/m with m>1/tau lie in strict N3, have nonzero spectrum {1,-1,1}, yet every physical cross cut has rank at most two.
The strict-N3 star-plus-bank family above has a continuous density bounded by 3*2^(4/3)<7.56 for every independent cap-one input law, by the pinned Theorem-H hub estimate.
Three disjoint rank-one banks with coordinate masses <=delta<1/2 have density cap <=12/sqrt(1-4delta^2); even uniform three-bank strict-N3 forms have cap <=12, by account03/B18 r19.

Along any target-valid sequence whose output density caps tend to infinity, sup over physical cuts of e_5(A_IJ^T A_IJ) tends to zero; exact rank-three and rank-four cross singular products also vanish at the rates forced by account03/B18 r19.
